title: Permit decision where legal responsibility remains external
operational_setting: An automated system evaluates permit criteria and produces a decision record, while legal responsibility is assigned by statute rather than system provenance.
trust_boundary: Government decision affects an external rights-bearing party.

attack.procedure: Keep responsibility entirely outside the technical event model and test whether the operational system remains complete while legal attribution is determined separately.

success_criteria_for_attack: If the technical system operates correctly and law supplies responsibility, Responsibility should remain an external institutional function rather than a core protocol primitive.

verdict.rationale: Designed to limit protocol-level responsibility claims.
